method: Continuous bank regrade within original water corridor; 4m smoothing and 2–4m height-domain warp; walk elevations allowed at most 0.8m initial adjustment and ramp elevations 0.6m, followed by adjacent-walk grade constraint
grade_constraint: For each adjacent pair of walkable 0.8m vertices: abs(dz) <= max(original abs(dz),0.56m), tolerance 0.01m
warning: Author trial; preserve path flags and constrain slopes, but visually inspect banks, reground all placements, and rerun map navigation sampling. This is not full collision acceptance.
